inputs.checklistItemText: Final road and driveway grades do not maintain minimum 30-foot vertical clearance from electric transmission lines to ground surface
inputs.question: Are there any electric transmission lines (69kV, 138kV, or 345kV voltage levels) indicated on the utility plan, grading plan, or site plan? Or are all overhead electric facilities distribution-level only?

output.reasoning: The agent is performing a presence check to determine whether transmission-level electric lines exist on the plans at all, which is a prerequisite to the clearance measurement. This is sheet discovery and feature identification, not yet a measurement or drawing-relationship inspection.
